mapper.insert: insert into users(username, password_hash, email, full_name, phone_number, created_at, updated_at, is_active, last_login) values (#{username}, #{passwordHash}, #{email}, #{fullName}, #{phoneNumber}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}, #{isActive}, #{lastLogin})
mapper.update: update users set username = #{username}, password_hash = #{passwordHash}, email = #{email}, full_name = #{fullName}, phone_number = #{phoneNumber}, created_at = NOW()
